launch_cmd_note: build_barehull.sh captures rc INSIDE the wrapper (never around a setsid line -- `setsid timeout cmd` exits 0 for every outcome). It runs GATE X5 FIRST, BEFORE ANY GEOMETRY OR MESH IS BUILT, with --selftest so the planted control is armed before the real comparison; a geometry gate evaluable only after a build is a gate evaluated under pressure to pass. It then emits the case, runs blockMesh -> snappyHexMesh -overwrite -> checkMesh, requires an 'End' line from each, and REFUSES if a 'sail' patch appears or the patch count is not exactly 5 (inlet outlet farfield symm hull).
